prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The film, _____ I watched last night, was moving.
options: which
that
what

wrong.that: 逗號後的非限定子句不能用 that。
wrong.what: what 不能接在名詞 film 後面當關係代名詞。

why: 補充說明的非限定子句，指物用 which。
say: The film, which I watched last night, was moving.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ it was raining, we went hiking.
options: Although
Because
Unless

wrong.Because: because 表示原因，但下雨並不是去健行的原因。
wrong.Unless: unless 是「除非」，會變成「除非下雨，否則去健行」，與 was raining 的事實矛盾。

why: 下雨卻仍去健行，是讓步關係，用 although。
tip: 雖然下雨還是去，用 although。
say: Although it was raining, we went hiking.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Having finished his homework, Tom went to bed.
Have finished his homework, Tom went to bed.
Having finish his homework, Tom went to bed.
answer: Having finished his homework, Tom went to bed.

wrong.Have finished his homework, Tom went to: 分詞構句不能用 have 開頭，完成式的分詞構句是 having + 過去分詞。
wrong.Having finish his homework, Tom went to: having 後面要接過去分詞 finished，不能接原形 finish。

why: 寫完功課發生在睡覺之前，用 having + p.p. 表示先發生。
tip: 先發生的動作，用 having + p.p.。
say: Having finished his homework, Tom went to bed.

prompt: 你淋濕了，想說「如果我帶了傘，就不會淋濕了」。哪一句最適合？
options: If I had brought an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
If I brought an umbrella, I wouldn't get wet.
If I would bring an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
answer: If I had brought an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.

wrong.If I brought an umbrella, I wouldn't get: 這是與現在事實相反的假設，但事情已經發生，要用過去完成式。
wrong.If I would bring an umbrella, I wouldn't: if 子句不能用 would，過去的假設應用 had + p.p.。

why: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had + p.p.，主句用 would have + p.p.。
tip: 過去的假設：had + p.p.，would have + p.p.。
say: If I had brought an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.

prompt: 這位同學的推論有什麼問題？
text: A school bans phones. A student says, "Because some students misuse phones, all phones should be banned."
options: 以少數人的行為，去限制所有人
他沒有舉出任何例子
他說話太客氣
answer: 以少數人的行為，去限制所有人

wrong.他沒有舉出任何例子: 他有提出「有些學生濫用手機」這個理由，只是推到所有人太過度。
wrong.他說話太客氣: 推論是否合理看的是邏輯，與語氣客不客氣無關。

why: 從部分人的行為推到全體，屬於過度概括。
tip: 部分不代表全部，小心過度概括。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的語句。
text: Not only _____ the exam, but she also won a scholarship.
options: did she pass
she passed
she did pass

wrong.she passed: Not only 放在句首時，後面要倒裝，不能用一般語序。
wrong.she did pass: 助動詞要放在主詞前面（did she），不是放在主詞後面。

why: 否定副詞片語 Not only 在句首，後面主詞與助動詞倒裝。
tip: Not only 放句首，後面要倒裝。
say: Not only did she pass the exam, but she also won a scholarship.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: It is essential that every student _____ the form by Friday.
options: submit
submits
submitted

wrong.submits: 在 essential 之後的 that 子句，動詞用原形，不隨主詞加 s。
wrong.submitted: 這類假設語氣用原形動詞，不用過去式。

why: 表示必要、建議的形容詞後，that 子句用原形動詞。
tip: essential that 後面用原形動詞。
say: It is essential that every student submit the form by Friday.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Seldom have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Seldom I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
Seldom have seen I such a beautiful sunset.
answer: Seldom have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

wrong.Seldom I have seen such a beautiful suns: seldom 放句首時要倒裝，助動詞 have 要在主詞 I 前面。
wrong.Seldom have seen I such a beautiful suns: 倒裝只移動助動詞，主詞 I 要放在 have 後面、過去分詞前面。

why: 否定副詞 seldom 在句首，要把助動詞放在主詞之前。
say: Seldom have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Despite the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
options: 儘管塞車，我們還是準時到達
因為塞車，我們才準時到達
除非塞車，我們才會準時到達
answer: 儘管塞車，我們還是準時到達

wrong.因為塞車，我們才準時到達: despite 表示讓步，不是因果關係，塞車不會讓人準時。
wrong.除非塞車，我們才會準時到達: despite 不是 unless，句中也沒有條件的意思。

why: despite 表示「儘管」，後面說明結果出乎預期。
tip: despite 接名詞，意思是儘管。
say: Despite the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.

prompt: 你在寫評論，想補充說明這個計畫成本低，而且也有效。哪一組最適合？
options: The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is effective.
The plan is cheap. However, it is effective.
The plan is cheap. Otherwise, it is effective.
answer: The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is effective.

wrong.The plan is cheap. However, it is effect: however 表示轉折，但便宜和有效都是優點，沒有轉折。
wrong.The plan is cheap. Otherwise, it is effe: otherwise 是「否則」，這裡沒有條件關係，語意不通。

why: 兩個都是優點，用 moreover 追加說明。
tip: 追加優點用 moreover，不用 however。
say: The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is effective.

prompt: 根據這句話，哪個推論最合理？
text: The graph shows rising sales, yet profits fell.
options: 營收增加但利潤下降，可能是成本也升高了
銷售量下降了
利潤上升了
answer: 營收增加但利潤下降，可能是成本也升高了

wrong.銷售量下降了: 句中 rising sales 表示銷售增加，不是下降。
wrong.利潤上升了: profits fell 是利潤下降，不是上升。

why: 銷售增加但利潤下降，最合理的原因是成本增加。
tip: 同時看兩個數據，再推測原因。
